19204.d: Oo'glog (IPAc-en | ˈ | uː | ɡ | l | ɒ | ɡ Respell-en | OO | glog ) is an Ogress city and spa that plays an important part in the As a First Resort quest.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Possible options to reach Oo'glog include:
• Use the Master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Chief Tess directly inside Oo'glog (requires Archaeology Guildmaster Qualification)
• Teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone to arrive north outside its walls
• Travel by Charter ship (requires completion of As a First Resort) from a relevant dock elsewhere. The charter trip costs up to 5,000 coins depending upon the port of departure. The price can be halved twice if the player has done the Cabin Fever quest and is wearing a Ring of charos (a).
• Use the Volcanic trapper outfit (with 39 Hunter) teleport to Wimpy bird hunting area, just outside the entrance of Oo'glog. The teleport option is accessed by selecting the right-click option 'teleport' on the head while wearing the outfit, then 'bird snaring' in the susequent menu.
• Players with 57 Summoning may use a Spirit Larupia to teleport to the Feldip Hills hunter area just north of Oo'glog.
• Teleport to the Warforge Dig Site - either via a Spirit tree, a Ring of duelling, the South Feldip Hills Teleport in the regular spellbook, or the Archaeology fast travel table in the Archaeology Campus (requires 76 Archaeology) - and run east to Oo'glog from there. There are many medium-level monsters between the centre and Oo'glog, but Protect from Melee can be used to avoid all damage with prayer points then being recharged at the spa's sulphur spring.
• The Eagle transport system can be used to reach the jungle hunter area north of Oo'glog. Players with 29 Agility may also use the shortcut on the north wall to avoid the various aggressive creatures near the west entrance.

19205.d: The Oo'glog bank is the bank in Oo'glog.

19206.d: The Oo'glog Hunter area is a Hunter training area located just south of Oo'glog.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• South Feldip Hills Teleport (level 10 Magic).
• Spirit tree teleport to south Feldip Hills. Requires completion of Tree Gnome Village quest.
• Ring of duelling teleport to south Feldip Hills or Castle Wars.
• Teleport to Oo'glog lodestone and run south.
• Teleport to Warforge Dig Site via master archaeologist's outfit or dig sites map and run north-east.
